steps.name: QC and filtering of Salmon gene counts
steps.question: Given the 12000x13 Salmon gene-count matrix and 12-sample metadata (4 subjects x control/treated_a/treated_b), what is the library-size distribution, and which low-count genes should be filtered before differential expression?
acceptance_criteria: Confirms sample count matches metadata (12 samples: 4 subjects x 3 conditions) and reports the extra column (gene ID or annotation) in the 13-column counts file
Reports per-sample library sizes and flags any outlier sample
Applies and reports a low-count filter (e.g. genes with count >=10 in at least 4 samples) with number of genes retained
Outputs a filtered raw count matrix and updated gene list for downstream DESeq2 modeling

steps.name: DESeq2 paired model with three condition contrasts
steps.question: Within the same 4 subjects, which genes are differentially expressed in treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, and treated_a vs treated_b, controlling for subject as a paired/blocking factor?
acceptance_criteria: Fits a single DESeq2 model on the filtered count matrix with design ~ subject + condition (subject as blocking factor, condition as 3-level factor: control, treated_a, treated_b)
Extracts three pairwise contrasts from the one fit: treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, treated_a vs treated_b
Applies independent filtering and reports genes at padj < 0.05 (and log2FC) per contrast, with results tables saved for each contrast
Uses apeglm or ashr shrinkage for log2FC reporting and states which was used
Reports the number of significant genes per contrast and a summary table

steps.name: Union of treatment-responsive genes and A-vs-B concordance
steps.question: Which genes respond to either treatment A or treatment B relative to control (union of significant genes from treated_a-vs-control and treated_b-vs-control), and among those, how concordant or divergent are the A and B effect sizes, per the direct treated_a-vs-treated_b contrast?
acceptance_criteria: Computes the union and intersection of significant genes (padj<0.05) from treated_a-vs-control and treated_b-vs-control
Reports genes significant in the direct treated_a-vs-treated_b contrast as genes where the two treatments differ from each other
For the union gene set, correlates treated_a-vs-control log2FC against treated_b-vs-control log2FC and reports the correlation coefficient to characterize concordance
Produces a labeled table classifying each responsive gene as A-only, B-only, shared-concordant, or shared-divergent (divergent = significant in the direct A-vs-B contrast)
Outputs a Venn/UpSet-style summary and the classified gene table as CSV

steps.name: Pathway enrichment per contrast using WikiPathways human gene sets
steps.question: Which WikiPathways human pathways are enriched among genes differentially expressed in treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, and treated_a vs treated_b, and do the two treatments converge on shared pathways or diverge?
acceptance_criteria: Confirms the WikiPathways human GMT reference is present at run time before use; if absent, reports the gap and skips enrichment rather than fabricating results
Runs over-representation or GSEA-style enrichment (e.g. fgsea or clusterProfiler) separately for treated_a-vs-control, treated_b-vs-control, and treated_a-vs-treated_b significant/ranked gene lists
Reports enriched pathways with adjusted p-value per contrast
Compares enriched pathway sets between treated_a-vs-control and treated_b-vs-control to report shared versus treatment-specific pathways
Saves per-contrast enrichment tables

plan.title: Paired 3-condition blood DE: control vs treatment A/B
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is a paired within-subject comparison across three conditions (control, treated_a, treated_b) in 4 subjects (12 samples total, 12000 genes, raw Salmon counts). This calls for a single DESeq2 model with subject as a blocking factor and condition as the factor of interest, followed by three pairwise contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, treated_a vs treated_b) extracted from one fit so the paired structure is respected and dispersion is estimated once across all 12 samples rather than per-pairwise subset. QC and normalization run first on the full count matrix to confirm gene filtering and library-size behavior before modeling. After DE, gene lists per contrast feed pathway enrichment (WikiPathways human, confirmed present in refs) to characterize what each treatment perturbs and whether A and B converge on shared or distinct biology. A final step overlaps the three DE gene sets to directly answer 'which genes respond to either treatment' (union of A-vs-control and B-vs-control) and 'do A and B differ' (the direct A-vs-B contrast plus concordance of A/B effect sizes among genes responsive to either).
